item.title: Café Reel With Matching Captions

turns.text: Make these into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in', 'Coffee first', 'Something sweet', 'Made with care', 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read.

item.tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

answer_sheet.Photo order and caption mapping: Storefront: Come on in. Latte: Coffee first. Pastries: Something sweet. Barista: Made with care. Interior: Stay a while.
answer_sheet.Caption language and styling: English, with the exact supplied wording. Font, placement and animation are your call, but keep everything easy to read.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Mellow music; track choice is your call. No voiceover needed.

must_haves: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.

turns.text: Make these photos into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: the storefront pic — 'Come on in'; the latte pic — 'Coffee first'; the pastries pic — 'Something sweet'; the barista pic — 'Made with care'; the interior pic — 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** For this reel, I recommend a simple photo slideshow—not AI animation.

### Your 10-second layout
Vertical **9:16**, with each photo held for 2 seconds:

| Time | Photo | Caption |
|---|---|---|
| 0–2s | Storefront | Come on in |
| 2–4s | Latte | Coffee first |
| 4–6s | Pastries | Something sweet |
| 6–8s | Barista | Made with care |
| 8–10s | Interior | Stay a while |

Use large white text on a dark backing, inside the frame’s safe margins, with mellow instrumental music.

### Cost options
- **Cheapest: ordinary slideshow editing — 0 Magic Hour generation credits.** Assemble the original photos and captions in an editor, using music you own or are licensed to use.
- **AI-animated version at free-plan 480p — estimated 250 credits:** 240 for 10 seconds of video, plus 10 for production music. Animation isn’t necessary for your request and could alter photo details.
- **Shorter AI version: 5 seconds — estimated 125 credits**, including production music, but one second per caption would feel rushed.
- **Smaller:** 480p is already the lowest available video setting here; lowering it further isn’t an available saving.

**One limitation:** the no-generation slideshow tool needs downloadable image URLs; it rejected the attached Magic Hour file paths during the free planning check. So I can’t currently assemble that cheapest version here from these attachments alone.

**My recommendation:** keep the full 10 seconds and use a non-AI slideshow. It preserves your photos and readable wording without spending hundreds of credits. Would you prefer that route, or the estimated **250-credit animated version**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the 0-credit, 10-second non-AI slideshow.

dialog.agent:
I’ll keep it **10 seconds, non-AI, with no credit spending**.

There’s still one blocker: the slideshow tool can’t read the attached Magic Hour file paths—it requires **direct downloadable image URLs**. Please send those links for the five photos so I can try assembling them without generation.

Mellow music also needs to be an existing track you’re licensed to use; generating music would cost credits. Please provide a downloadable audio link too.

**Nothing has run or been charged.**
dialog.user: I don’t have downloadable links or a music track to provide. Is there a way to use the attached photos without spending credits?

dialog.agent:
**Yes—using a regular video editor, but I can’t complete it here with the available tools.** Your photos are attached; the limitation is that the free slideshow tool can’t access their Magic Hour file paths. Sorry I suggested that route before confirming it would work.

You can make it without spending Magic Hour credits in **Canva, CapCut, or iMovie**:

1. Create a **9:16 vertical** project.
2. Add the five original photos in order, each lasting **2 seconds**.
3. Add these captions in large white text on a dark backing:
   - Storefront — **Come on in**
   - Latte — **Coffee first**
   - Pastries — **Something sweet**
   - Barista — **Made with care**
   - Interior — **Stay a while**
4. Choose a **free mellow instrumental** from the editor’s library, checking that its licence allows your intended use—especially if promoting the café.
5. Export using free settings, avoiding premium assets or effects.

For landscape photos, use **Fit** rather than filling the frame, so the storefront and interior aren’t heavily cropped.

**No credits have been spent.**
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:

- Create a **9:16** project and import the five photos in the supplied order.
- Set each photo to **2 seconds**.
- Add, respectively: **Come on in → Coffee first → Something sweet → Made with care → Stay a while**.
- Use large white captions with a dark background.
- Add a free mellow instrumental licensed for your use, then export without premium effects.

**Nothing has run or been charged.**
